matched_excess_separation.site_policy: reselect the unadjusted PCA-space mean-shift trace-ratio maximum for every task-label assignment
matched_excess_separation.prompt_features: fold-local character-within-word TF-IDF 3-5 grams followed by truncated SVD
matched_excess_separation.classifier: cuML QN logistic regression with L2 penalty and penalty_normalized=true
matched_excess_separation.randomization: retain both orientations of all balanced assignments; share one deterministic fit per label-complement pair

negative_control.assignment: alphabetically first eight tasks in the fixed task order versus the remaining eight
negative_control.evaluation: treat this assignment in turn as observed against the same complete assignment distribution
negative_control.status: specified before any completed matched-excess report was inspected

matched_excess_separation.claim_limit: A significant positive difference is excess task-label predictability relative to this prompt representation, not proof of prompt-independent computation.

lexical_adjustment_diagnostics.fit_scope: training tasks within each grouped fold

task_identity_diagnostic.split: five-fold example split stratified within task
task_identity_diagnostic.role: diagnostic only; never used as knowledge-versus-reasoning inference

lexical_adjustment_diagnostics.fold_balance_audit: enumerate every assignment and report train/test task counts by class

positive_control.calibration_partition: alphabetically first eight tasks in the fixed task order versus the remaining eight
positive_control.injection_stage: raw activation space before fold-local lexical residualization, 95%-variance PCA, and probing
positive_control.lexical_adjustment: fold-local character-within-word TF-IDF 3-5 grams, 64-component truncated SVD, Ridge alpha=1
positive_control.scale_definition: global sample standard deviation of the unadjusted activation projected on the seeded unit direction; reported mean difference is twice the half-shift
positive_control.primary_output: fraction of direction seeds with exact task-level p<0.01 at each shift
positive_control.claim_limit: This calibrates the lexical-adjusted fixed-site probe conditional on one model, site, and arbitrary task partition; it does not calibrate layer selection or supply model evidence.
